description: Controls what the Accountant Agent is permitted to write into this ERP. This is the authoritative policy - it is enforced server-side inside your own system, so it holds even if the agent platform is misconfigured. Everything is off by default.

fields.description: The agent cannot write anything at all until this is enabled. Fail-closed by design.
fields.label: Enable Agent Writes

fields.description: Evaluation mode: the agent validates everything it would create but writes nothing. Recommended for the first two weeks of any deployment.
fields.label: Dry Run Only

fields.description: Require an explicit human approval in the chat before any document is written.
fields.label: Require Human Approval
Restrict To Listed Document Types
fields.description: Leave this off - the default - and the agent may prepare any document your own ERP permissions allow its user to, which is the setting most practices want. Tick it to narrow the agent to the list below, and only the document types you add there will be permitted.
A document type absent from this table cannot be written, regardless of the agent user's role permissions. Both this table and the agent user's ERP permissions must allow an action.
fields.label: Allowed Document Types

fields.description: Maximum number of documents the agent may write in a single run.
fields.label: Max Documents Per Run

fields.description: Maximum aggregate absolute value the agent may write in a single run. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Max Total Amount Per Run

fields.description: The agent may not post with a date earlier than this many days ago.
fields.label: Posting Date - Max Days Back

fields.description: The agent may not post with a future date beyond this many days. 0 forbids future-dating.
fields.label: Posting Date - Max Days Forward

fields.description: Leave empty to permit every company the agent user can already access. This is a second layer alongside User Permissions, not a replacement for them.
fields.label: Allowed Companies

fields.description: Accounts the agent may never touch, whatever its permissions - typically retained earnings, suspense and tax control accounts.
fields.label: Blocked Accounts

name: Agent Write Policy
